primary_source.paper: CSZ Paper II, Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs II: Finding an Excellent Precoloring
primary_source.source_definition: For every other 3-list L', Z(L') consists of v in Y'_{L'} having a non-neighbor n in {y1,y2} whose chosen color g(n) lies in L'; source then assigns v the unique color in L'\L0.
primary_source.source_role: The Z construction explicitly handles the xv=0 side; acceptability is consumed only at the final equivalence step to certify that an arbitrary extension agrees with the forced Z colors.

literature_search.source: Chudnovsky et al., Covering minimal separators and potential maximal cliques in P_t-free graphs, EJC 2021
literature_search.result: For P7-free graphs, every minimal separator S has a set S' of size at most 22 with S contained in N[S'].
literature_search.mismatch: Residual Y0/fiber interfaces in Lemma 11 are not established to be minimal separators, and a 22-vertex neighborhood cover is not a bound on survivor-fiber signatures.

literature_search.source: Lozin-Zamaraev, The structure and the number of P7-free bipartite graphs, EJC 2017
literature_search.result: P7-free bipartite graphs admit a decomposition scheme based on connected/co-connected and bounded partition steps.
literature_search.mismatch: The survivor/Y0 induced structure is not established to be bipartite after retaining all proof-relevant edges, and the result does not bound the exact seeded/list interface rank required here.
